scripts.dev: npm run build -w dashboard-mf && npm run build -w trade-mf && npm run build -w payment-mf && npm run build -w analytics-mf && concurrently -k -n shell,dashboard,trade,payment,analytics -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w shell" "npm run preview -w dashboard-mf" "npm run preview -w trade-mf" "npm run preview -w payment-mf" "npm run preview -w analytics-mf"
scripts.build: npm run build -w dashboard-mf && npm run build -w trade-mf && npm run build -w payment-mf && npm run build -w analytics-mf && npm run build -w shell
scripts.clean: npm run clean -w dashboard-mf --if-present && npm run clean -w trade-mf --if-present && npm run clean -w payment-mf --if-present && npm run clean -w analytics-mf --if-present && npm run clean -w shell --if-present
